decision_conditions: It is considered that the collection of roof forms would not be in-keeping with the host dwelling and would appear overly dominant. Additionally, the overall scale of the two storey side extension would not appear subordinate to the host building. The proposal would not be acceptable given the character of the surrounding area. It would result in a jarring and incongruous appearance which would have an unacceptable impact on the existing street scene. The resulting develoment would conflict with Paragraph 135 of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024, Policies D3 of the London Plan 2021, and Policy DM10 of the Council's Core Strategy 2012.

The proposal would have a material impact on the levels of daylight received in habitable windows at Nos 118 and 120 Richmond Road as well as a material impact on the levels of sunlight reaching the rear garden of No 118 Richmond Road. Furthermore, due to the siting, scale and the proposed separation distances, the proposal is likely to result in unnacceptable impact to the outlook from windows of habitable rooms at Nos 118 and 120 Richmond Road and would likley appear as overbearing when viewed from the adjoining properties. The proposal, given the proposed separation distances and its siting, would also result in an unacceptable loss of privacy and undue overlooking in relation to the property at No 122 Richmond Road.  As such, the proposal is contrary to policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that the proposal would not have an adverse impact on the existing car parking arrangement and would not lead to increased car parking pressures within the surrounding area that may lead to inconsiderate parking and therefore jeopardise highway safety. The proposal is therefore contrary to Paragraph 115 of the NPPF, 2024 and Policies DM9 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
description: Erection of rear piggy back roof extension with installation of side rooflights to facilitate loft conversion and two storey side extension to create attached 2no. bedroom annex. Changes to fenestrations.
